title: Comparative analysis of stability and removal torque of custom CAD-CAM versus stock abutments before and after cyclic loading: A systematic review with meta-analysis and GRADE analysis
html: Advancements in computer-aided design and computer-aided manufacturing (CAD-CAM) have enabled greater precision and customization in implant abutment fabrication. However, current evidence remains limited regarding the comparative mechanical stability and torque retention of stock versus CAD-CAM-fabricated abutments, particularly under dynamic loading conditions.
